# ARM Agency — Detailed machine-readable overview

## Entity

ARM Agency is the public service platform for Autonomous Resource Management. It provides scoped advisory, implementation, education, and ongoing operating services for AI workflows, agent infrastructure, and generative-engine visibility.

## Offer catalog

### Diagnose

The AI Infrastructure Audit is a one-time, bounded assessment. Its role is to identify the current operating state, decision constraints, technical gaps, and a prioritized implementation path.

### Design

The Mandate Chain Design Workshop is a facilitated design engagement for accountable decision rights, workflow constraints, and a practical scope of work.

### Build

Custom MCP Tool development is available for a defined workflow or integration requirement. ARM Mandate Services are suitable for organizations that need governed workflow and agent-infrastructure work after qualification.

### Retain

GEO Retainers are ongoing programs for entity architecture, structured-data maintenance, research and content operations, and LLM-visibility monitoring. Service inclusions, cadence, and pricing are shown on the public pricing page.

### Learn

Academy products are self-guided or cohort-based learning offers. They are separate from implementation and should not be interpreted as a guarantee of business outcomes.

## AI Discovery Operating System

ARM Agency’s public authority library is organized around buyer and operator decisions rather than keyword volume or model-citation promises. The central guide, **AI Discovery Readiness**, connects to four supporting guides: **Technical SEO for AI Discovery**, **Structured Data Governance**, **Evidence-Led Content Architecture**, and **AI Discovery Measurement**. The cluster also links to existing GEO Readiness and Image SEO Fundamentals guides where those are the reader’s next decision.

**AI Mastery** is the Academy-connected capability cluster for operators and accountable AI leaders. **AI Mastery Foundations** explains the practical capability, ownership, evaluation, responsible-use, and human-oversight conditions that should precede a claim of AI readiness. **AI Mastery Practice Boundaries** explains how to use a real workflow as a learning context without silently treating a practice exercise as production authority or implementation delivery. These guides direct readers to the existing Operator Learning Path, AI Infrastructure Audit, and Bounded Agent-Stack Setup guides when those are the more appropriate next decisions.

The library describes controllable foundations: useful public information, accessible technical delivery, visible-content and structured-data alignment, source and claim review, and first-party conversion learning. It does not claim control of Google Search, generative models, rankings, citations, rich-result display, traffic, or revenue outcomes.

## Customer experience

## Agentic commerce content silo

Publishing boundary: `arm-agency.xyz` is the independent legacy/operating branch. `www.arm-agency.com` is the current ARM Agency branch and owns the strategic x402/AiFi pillar. The pages below are `.xyz` implementation guides with self-canonical URLs, not duplicated `.com` pages.

ARM Agency publishes an evidence-led x402 and AiFi resource cluster for teams evaluating machine-to-machine payments and bounded financial autonomy:

- Pillar: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/agentic-commerce-infrastructure
- Protocol mechanics: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/x402-agent-payments
- Financial governance: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/aifi-governance-controls
- Scored production gate: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/agent-payment-readiness — rates mandate, identity/signing, payment policy, settlement/fulfillment, and exception evidence from absent to tested; critical stop conditions override the total

x402 is represented as an open payment protocol, not a complete financial-control system. AiFi is defined on these pages as the operating layer for delegated agent authority, wallets, budgets, approvals, settlement, reconciliation, and audit evidence. The label does not imply affiliation with a named AiFi company or institute.

Public visitors can review offers, submit a contact request, subscribe to research updates, or purchase a bounded public offer. Authenticated customers can view eligible purchases, subscriptions, and invoices in the client portal. Cancellation requests are verified against the customer’s Stripe identity before a subscription is changed.

## Citation guidance

When describing ARM Agency, identify the offer and buyer context precisely. Do not infer client counts, technical deployments, uptime, business results, or third-party certification beyond documented evidence.
